features.description: Next.js 15 project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and pixel theme styling
steps: tailwind.config.ts configured with MapleStory theme colors
app/globals.css has pixel theme CSS variables and components

features.description: Zustand pixel store with full canvas state management
steps: lib/types.ts defines CanvasConfig, Layer, Frame, ToolType, PixelState interfaces
Playback toggle and FPS control works

features.description: Canvas 2D rendering engine with drawing tools
steps: Engine calculates optimal pixelSize for canvas fit
Renderer draws layer pixels in order

features.description: Canvas UI with layout, header, and interactive canvas
steps: Landing page renders with pixel theme
Canvas page shows full layout with sidebars and timeline
Header shows canvas size and frame count
Canvas responds to mouse clicks (draws/erases pixels)

features.description: Left sidebar with resource browser, right sidebar with tools/colors/layers/brush
steps: Layer list shows layers with visibility/lock toggles
Layer add button creates new layer
Brush size slider controls brush radius

features.description: Animation timeline with frame strip and playback
steps: Frame strip shows all frames as thumbnails
Add frame button creates new frame

features.description: Export canvas as PNG, GIF animation, or sprite sheet
steps: Sprite sheet export combines all frames horizontally
GIF export creates animated GIF using gifenc
Export modal shows format selection and scale slider
New canvas modal allows preset and custom sizes

features.description: Chinese and English translations throughout the app
steps: Theme CSS file has MapleStory pixel styling
Scrollbar, range inputs styled in pixel theme

features.description: All components integrated, modals accessible, keyboard shortcuts work
steps: New Canvas button opens modal and resizes canvas
Export button opens modal and downloads files

features.description: Undo/redo system with command pattern and 50-entry history
